Name: ✦ Carrot Chase
Description: <light_purple>Dangle the stick and it will follow you to the end of the world.
- <blue><bold>Ride</bold> <reset>it — a carrot on a stick is all the steering it needs
- A truffle-snouted <green><bold>Pickup</bold> <reset>reach that only gets longer
- A short <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>burst and a hardy little <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool

Notifications.20: <light_purple>The stick swings into place and it can't help but follow — Carrot Chase begins.
Notifications.60: <light_purple>It has never once caught the carrot, and never once stopped trying.
